query: with a as(select * from public.authors where open_library_id=any(array['OL8106910A','OL33146A']::text[])),w as(select * from public.works where open_library_id=any(array['OL17864836W','OL498556W']::text[])) select jsonb_build_object('checked_at',clock_timestamp(),'project','hlvujbrmfdlrfxdjwsmb','authors',(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(t) order by id),'[]') from a t),'author_corpora',(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(t) order by id),'[]') from public.works t where author_id in(select id from a)),'works',(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(t) order by id),'[]') from w t),'editions',(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(t) order by id),'[]') from public.editions t where work_id in(select id from w) or isbn_13=any(array['9781982150921','9781098540685','9789025327422','9789025470104']::text[]) or open_library_edition_id=any(array['OL29762592M','OL41072530M','OL12800799M','OL60598620M']::text[])),'reserved_range',jsonb_build_object('works',(select count(*) from public.works where id between 987148001 and 987148999),'editions',(select count(*) from public.editions where id between 987248001 and 987248999),'authors',(select count(*) from public.authors where id between 987348001 and 987348999))) as preflight;
